## 

There's multiple beautiful towns close to Hamburg that can be reached with public transport

## Suggestions

Lübeck \~ 45 mins by train

Lüneburg \~ 30 mins by train

Schwerin \~ 1 hour by train

## What to do?

-   Visit the beach closeby to Lübeck

-   Take a stroll through the old town of Lüneburg

-   Visit Schwerin castle
